en.headline: 7 commits, 2 issues opened, and 1 discussion started on 2026-10-16
en.summary: On 2026-10-16, `sogeisetsu` made **7 own commits** in `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, plus 4 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. The own commits were all documentation work: adding an `AGENTS.md` and noting the origin remote, creating a `knowledge/` base for Git & GitHub findings with Excalidraw sketches, generalizing the knowledge section from Git/GitHub to broader topics, making knowledge supplementation the default action with adjustable architecture, and archiving OpenCode V2 distribution/architecture/auth plus Windows path pitfalls and oh-my-opencode-slim / hosted OpenCode field notes. Two issues were opened in `anomalyco/opencode`: `#55785` reporting that `mimo-v2.6-flash` and `mimo-v2.5` advertise image input but the Go endpoint rejects every image with a 400, and `#55772` requesting a way to run the CLI shipped with the Windows desktop build. One discussion was started in `openchamber/openchamber`: `#4982` titled "Share session archive state with OpenCode's own clients" under the Ideas category. No pull requests, reviews, releases, stars, or replies were recorded for the day.

zh.headline: 2026-10-16 共 7 次提交、新开 2 个 issue、发起 1 个讨论
zh.summary: 2026-10-16，`sogeisetsu` 在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 完成 **7 次本人提交**，另有 4 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 自动提交。本人提交全部为文档工作：新增 `AGENTS.md` 并标注 origin 远程、创建 `knowledge/` 目录用于归档 Git & GitHub 相关发现并附 Excalidraw 草图、将 knowledge 章节从 Git/GitHub 泛化为「各种知识」、把 knowledge 补充改为默认动作并允许架构随内容调整，以及归档 OpenCode V2 分发/架构/认证与 Windows 路径坑、oh-my-opencode-slim 与托管 OpenCode 实测知识。在 `anomalyco/opencode` 新开了 2 个 issue：`#55785` 反映 `mimo-v2.6-flash` 与 `mimo-v2.5` 声明支持图像输入但 Go 端点拒绝所有图像（返回 400），`#55772` 提出 Windows 桌面版附带 CLI 却无运行方式。在 `openchamber/openchamber` 发起了 1 个讨论：`#4982`「Share session archive state with OpenCode's own clients」，归类于 Ideas。当日无 PR、review、release、star 或回复记录。
